research.name: Liquid Glass Studio
research.note: Browser playground that renders Apple-style liquid glass shapes with refraction, dispersion and merging blobs, tuned live through sliders.

effects: liquid glass refraction shader with chromatic dispersion on shape edges
SDF shapes that merge into one blob
frosted blur glass over photo and video backgrounds
live parameter panel for thickness, refraction, Fresnel, glare and shadow
